text: Take Lisinopril 10 mg by mouth once a day. Take Nitroglycerin 0.4 mg under the tongue once a day. Take Enoxaparin 40 mg as a shot under the skin once a day. Take Ceftriaxone 1 g as a shot into a muscle once a day. Take Vancomycin 1 g into a vein once a day. Take Albuterol 90 mcg breathed in once a day. Take Hydrocortisone 10 mg on the skin once a day. Take Fentanyl 25 mcg as a skin patch once a day. Take Acetaminophen 650 mg in the rectum once a day. Take Latanoprost 1.5 mcg in the eye once a day. Take Ofloxacin 0.75 mg in the ear once a day. Take Mometasone 50 mcg in the nose once a day.
